response.original_title: Miss Dior, A Story of Love and Perfume
response.overview: At the heart of Miss Dior Eau de Parfum blooms the legendary Grasse Rose, a flower deeply connected to the Dior family's history. Irreverent, elegant and recognizable at first glance, the Miss Dior dagger bow has now adopted the iconic House houndstooth pattern. A symbol of Dior's love for flowers and fragrance.
response.title: Miss Dior, A Story of Love and Perfume
